text.title: Text to humanize
text.description: The AI-sounding text you want rewritten. Everything else stays the same: facts, names, numbers, and quotes are kept.
text.prefill: I recently spent five unforgettable days in Lisbon, and let me tell you — this city completely stole my heart. From the moment I arrived, I knew I was somewhere truly special.

voiceSample.title: Writing sample (optional)
voiceSample.description: Two or three paragraphs of your own writing. The rewrite matches your rhythm, word choice, punctuation, and quirks.

model.title: Model
model.description: Any model your API provider serves, such as gpt-4o-mini or gpt-4.1.

baseUrl.title: OpenAI-compatible API base URL
baseUrl.description: The chat completions endpoint base. Works with OpenAI and any OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenRouter, Groq, Together, and so on).

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Lower is more consistent, higher is more varied.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key for the provider named in baseUrl. Stored encrypted and only used for the LLM call.
